claims.object_text: KCNA2 autoantibodies detectable in serum over 4 years with increasing titers
claims.quote: KCNA2 autoantibodies were also detectable in serum over 4 years with increasing titers over time.

claims.object_text: KCNA2 autoantibody persistence did not trigger poor long-term outcome (no cognitive progression)
claims.quote: KCNA2 autoantibody persistence in biomarker-supported AD does not necessarily trigger a poor outcome in the long-term, as cognitive impairment did not progress subsequently.

claims.object_text: mild immunotherapy did not reduce immunoreactivity for KCNA2 autoantibodies
claims.quote: At the same time, mild immunotherapy did not result in less immunoreactivity in conjunction with the detection of KCNA2 autoantibodies.

claims.object_text: KCNA2 autoantibodies could indicate a potentially benign long-term AD course
claims.quote: This detection of KCNA2 autoantibodies in AD could provide indices of a potentially benign long-term AD course that should be further evaluated in studies.
